known_input_contract.remote_commit_availability_basis: Root supplies commits after its actual fetch/readback. This helper checks local exact commit/tree objects and records provenance; this reviewer made no new remote verification.

source_inspection_findings.check: Exact overlay schema, HEAD binding, unique canonical manifest paths, and per-file applied after-byte/hash checks
No pre-existing staged changes; git add is restricted to the exact literal manifest path list; staged names use NUL delimiters
Reuse set comes from exact SHA-1 commits in the research object store or pinned release fallback; tree inventories include sparse-unchecked-out paths
Git calls set NO_LAZY_FETCH, NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS and LITERAL_PATHSPECS; the helper has no direct fetch, commit, push or API call
Target mode is obtained from the staged index and limited to regular-file modes 100644/100755; source-file mode is never copied through blob reuse
Every staged index blob SHA must equal the SHA-1 of the exact working bytes already bound to the overlay SHA-256, detecting Git filter or newline transformations
After write-tree, the immutable tree's complete allowed path/mode/blob mapping must equal the payload rows; its diff from base_tree must have exactly the allowed paths
Non-reused files retain the legacy UTF-8-at-most-50000-bytes or base64 semantics; reused files omit content/inline/encoding and carry reuse=true with their git_sha
The complete JSON is serialized with ensure_ascii=true before 32000-character chunking; reassembly must equal the full ASCII payload; full and per-chunk SHA-256 hashes are recorded
Output must be a fresh directory outside both repositories; missing files, symlinks and resolved path escape are rejected

resolved_review_finding.issue: The initial source verified index blob SHA before write-tree but only path sets afterward. A concurrent change to the contents of the same allowed index paths could leave expected_tree inconsistent with payload rows.
resolved_review_finding.resolution: Final source reads the immutable expected_tree with git ls-tree and requires the exact per-path target mode and blob SHA to equal every payload row before creating any transport output.

consumer_requirements_in_existing_payloa: Check reuse before reading inline/encoding/content. For reuse=true, directly reference the verified git_sha.
Use the target mode in each row; do not hardcode mode from the reused source file.
Concatenate all ASCII chunks in manifest order and verify their hashes and full payload identity before JSON.parse; individual chunks can split an escape sequence.
The receiving transport must continue to honor the bound head, base_tree and expected_tree. This source review does not certify the receiving V8 implementation.
operational_scope: This helper intentionally stages exact local files when root invokes it after the guarded overlay apply; it is not a dry-run tool. Failure after staging can leave the index staged and requires ordinary inspection. This receipt reports source review only, not that such an invocation or transport occurred.
